title: struthanthus retusus
intro: Struthanthus retusus, commonly known as the "Coral Root," is a type of plant that is a hemiparasitic orchid, meaning it obtains some of its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants. The health benefits of Struthanthus retusus include its potential to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Struthanthus retusus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Struthanthus retusus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
